correctness.rationale: For a functional transition, inverse image preserves Boolean operations. Every term is a Boolean expression in time-shifted input bits. Equality of term operations is precisely equality on all rooted traces realized across all colorings and worlds; a common finite prefix separates the finite trace set, so all 2^{|T|} bit assignments have explicit DNF terms. A trace with exact preperiod b and least tail period d occurs iff some orbit has h>=b and ell divisible by d. Primitive-root counting gives P_q(d) choices for b=0 and (q-1)q^{b-1}P_q(d) for b>0; the geometric sum is q^{H_d}P_q(d). For arity zero q=1 the formula gives exactly 2 constants. Direct closure, explicit trace enumeration, and independent modal partitions agree for all 288 maps on n<=4 at q=1,2,3 (864 cases) and 15 tiny direct term closures. Random large checks are only supporting tests. No unproved implication is used.

value.rationale: The complete arity-wise term-operation spectrum is an intrinsic finite algebra invariant, meaningful beyond the previously solved problem of deciding generation by one selected valuation. It admits a uniform exact formula for every finite functional digraph, compresses topology into a divisor–tail skyline, explains invisibility of branch/cycle multiplicities, quantifies different primitive cycle periods, and supplies polynomial degree and leading coefficient tied to longest forward orbits. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary tiny parameter slice, textbook identity alone, or computational-only table.
